name: MetricCard
description: KPI tile: label, value, directional delta (arrow + color) and supporting hint.
designIntent: Dashboards need comparable tiles. MetricCard standardizes tabular numbers, delta direction (never color-only) and the label/value/hint hierarchy so rows of KPIs align.

props.name: hint
props.description: Comparison context (vs last month). Alias: description.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color for the value (not the delta).

props.name: loading
props.description: Renders a skeleton instead of the value and sets aria-busy.

examples.title: KPI row
examples.description: Deltas carry arrows as well as color.

antiPatterns.title: Don't encode meaning in color alone
antiPatterns.explanation: Always pass trend so the arrow glyph accompanies the color.

accessibility.userRequirements: Include the sign in the delta string

guidelines: State the unit in value or hint
badExamples: Total revenue generated across all locations

compositionRules.relationship: Lay KPI rows out with Grid for even columns
